correctness.rationale: Definitions and dimensions are explicit. The connected 24-vertex 36-edge graph has a proved 23-dimensional vertex-switch gauge and 8192 complete sign classes. Standard-library exact code enumerates all 64 matchings and checks each signed sum against a separately formed integer Kasteleyn determinant. A complete histogram, Parseval and exact inverse Walsh checks yield rank 3411*2^23, nullity 4781*2^23, gap 8 and projector norm 82305/4096. The vertex-gauge sign symmetrization and translation-averaging minimization have elementary full-domain proofs. The finite exhaustive certificate establishes exactly the claimed finite instance, not an infinite extension.

value.rationale: A canonical 24-cell Aztec diamond furnishes a natural full independent-edge dimer measurement operator, whose exact information loss and endpoint amplification are not supplied by unsigned or limited-weight enumerations. The rank 3411/8192 of gauge classes contrasts with sharp endpoint projection norm 82305/4096 while nonzero Hilbert condition number is 8; this is a mathematically motivated finite stability benchmark with precise future use in signed-dimer recovery. No general-family or paper-scale impact is claimed.
